title: Claude 4: Opus 4 and Sonnet 4
hook: Claude 4 lets a model interleave reasoning with tool calls - thinking, calling a tool, thinking again, and even running tools in parallel - rather than reasoning once and answering.
key_points: Two models: Claude Opus 4, positioned as a top coding model, and Claude Sonnet 4, an upgrade over Sonnet 3.7.
Extended thinking with tool use (beta): models alternate between reasoning and tool calls, and can run tools in parallel.
Improved instruction-following and memory - the models can save facts when given local file access.
Available on the Anthropic API, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
content_html: Anthropic released Claude 4 in May 2025, a pair of models - Claude Opus 4, positioned as a top coding model, and Claude Sonnet 4, an upgrade over Sonnet 3.7. The headline capability is extended thinking with tool use, which lets the models weave reasoning and tool calls together rather than doing one then the other.
extra_html:
What's new

In the beta extended-thinking-with-tools mode, a Claude 4 model alternates between reasoning and tool calls - and can run tools in parallel - so it can think, gather information, and think again within a single task. Anthropic also cites improved instruction-following and memory: when given local file access, the models can save facts to refer back to.

Why it matters

Interleaving reasoning with tool use is the pattern agentic workflows depend on, and pulling it into the base models - rather than leaving it to external scaffolding - tightens how Claude handles multi-step coding and research tasks. Availability across the Anthropic API, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI makes the family easy to reach. See Anthropic's announcement for details.

related.title: The Claude 3 Model Family
related.hook: Anthropic's Claude 3 family offers a three-tier speed-capability tradeoff - Haiku, Sonnet, Opus - with multimodal input and alignment built on Constitutional AI methods.

related.title: Constitutional AI
related.hook: What if a model could critique and improve its own answers against a written set of principles, instead of relying on humans to label every harmful case?

related.title: OpenAI o3: Reasoning that Uses Tools
related.hook: o3 is the first reasoning model that can agentically reach for every ChatGPT tool mid-thought - web search, Python on your files, image input, image generation - and combine them to solve a problem.
